name: Stari Grad Plain
description: On the Adriatic island of Hvar in Croatia, the Stari Grad Plain is a patchwork of vineyards and olive groves laid out by Greek settlers from Paros in the 4th century BC. Dry-stone walls still divide the fields into the same rectangular plots, dotted with small stone huts called trims. Farmers have worked this fertile land for roughly 2,400 years.
